ratification_note: This is the worker's own gate set, defined so it can execute the moment the owner-approved mirror serves the ratified digest. It is not part of the ratified studio family (docs/audits/ugence_governance_studio_p3e/CONTAINER_GATE_FAMILY.json), reuses none of its identifiers, and adds nothing to that record; ratifying this set is a separate owner decision. No gate below is marked passed by this file.
execution_note: Every gate halts at mirror-digest-conformance with RESOURCE_BLOCKER_MIRROR_UNCONFIGURED until BASE_IMAGE_MIRROR_DECISION.json carries owner-supplied mirror coordinates. The runtime verification script has been validated by static parsing only; it has never run against a built image.
base_image_rule: the ratified python:3.11-slim-bookworm digest only; no new digest, no node image; base-images.json == BASE_IMAGE_MIRROR_DECISION.json == Dockerfile FROM lines
never: a re-pin, substitution or placeholder mirror coordinate
a gate marked passed without a real build from the ratified digest
a credential value printed, stored or committed

GRW-CTR-01.requirement: base-images.json and every Dockerfile FROM pin equal the ratified python digest; the worker pins no other image

GRW-CTR-02.requirement: the owner-approved mirror serves the ratified digest content-addressed to itself; docker.io never consulted

GRW-CTR-03.requirement: the image builds from the pinned Dockerfile for linux/amd64 through the mirror

GRW-CTR-04.requirement: runtime user 10001:10001; exposes 8444/tcp only; no compiler, npm or node in the runtime layer

GRW-CTR-05.requirement: the runtime package inventory is recorded from the built image

GRW-CTR-06.requirement: no secret in any layer: config, history and per-layer content scanned; no DSN, key or token

GRW-CTR-07.requirement: against the running container: every production refusal happens in preflight (public bind, plain HTTP, http JWKS, no identity port, in-memory store, missing DSN, unknown mode); non-root, no capabilities, no new privileges, read-only root with the volume and /tmp writable, stores on the volume; one private TLS listener with no published port, TLS <= 1.1 refused, no plaintext; healthz and an empty queue answer over TLS; no DSN in logs; egress observed and recorded as external evidence
GRW-CTR-07.requires_database: PostgreSQL 16 on the runner, reachable at the bridge gateway

GRW-CTR-08.requirement: a CycloneDX SBOM bound to the built image

GRW-CTR-09.requirement: no HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerability in the built image

GRW-CTR-10.requirement: the evidence manifest hashes only artifacts this run produced; INCOMPLETE whenever any mandatory producer did not succeed; marks no gate passed

evidence_manifest.artifact: grw-container-evidence (uploaded by the worker container job)
evidence_manifest.current_state: INCOMPLETE on every run: no producer succeeds before the mirror is configured
